description:
New opportunities in Europe!

🟢 Dev.Pro is a US-based software development company helping tech companies build their products and grow their business. We’re remote-first, and we work with independent contractors in over 55 countries, so you’d be collaborating in a multicultural environment on some really interesting projects.

We invite a Senior Software Engineer (Angular, Node.js) to join a new Voice AI initiative for a leading global payment technology provider with a strong presence in the Point of Sale (POS) industry. In this role, you’ll build and enhance enterprise solutions that run in real in-store payment and retail environments, working closely with engineers, QA, and product teams. You’ll develop full-stack features that connect with in-store devices, using AI-assisted tools in your daily work.

🟩 What's in it for you:

  • Help shape how voice technology is used in real in-store experiences
  • Build software that connects to in-store hardware over sockets and networking
  • Take ownership of features and technical decisions

✅ Is that you?

  • 5+ years of full-stack experience, with strong Angular (TypeScript) and Node.js proficiency
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and practical experience working with sockets
  • Experience integrating software with physical devices or hardware-related systems
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants
  • Experience writing unit tests and following code quality best practices
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams
  • Proven ability to work independently, own features end-to-end, and make sound technical decisions
  • Upper-Intermediate English level

Desirable:

  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with MongoDB
  • Experience with POS, payment systems, or similar in-store technology

🧩Key responsibilities and your contribution

In this role, you’ll collaborate with a team of engineers to develop and support Voice AI features for enterprise in-store solutions.

  • Design, develop, and maintain Angular-based features and Node.js services
  • Implement communication between components over sockets
  • Build and support integrations with physical devices and other in-store hardware
  • Work with QA, BA, and product teams on new features across connected systems
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and integrated systems
  • Guide implementation decisions, share knowledge, and help the team align on technical approaches
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to speed up delivery
  • Improve code quality, maintainability, and development practices within the team

Our next steps:

✅ Submit a CV in English — ✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Interview — ✅ Signing the Contract
